annotation.title_clean: ロボット介護機器開発ガイドブック
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AMED ロボット介護機器開発・導入促進事業 基準策定評価コンソーシアム
annotation.venue: AMED (Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese AMED guidebook for developers of robotic care devices, structured as a V-model development process: concept sheet, human-centred design, risk assessment templates, safety requirements and tests referencing ISO 13482/JIS standards, field-trial and ethics-review guidelines, standardization status, and a deployment guideline emphasising person-centred "improving care".
key_provisions_or_claims: Development follows a V-model that defines intended effects on care recipients and caregivers, including negative and long-term impacts, before mechanical requirements.
Risk assessment templates follow JIS B 9700 three-step method (inherent design, safeguarding, user information) with residual risk communication.
Safety requirements per care-robot type are mapped to ISO 13482 hazard list and JIS B 8445/8446 standards.
Field trials must proceed stepwise with prior mechanical safety verification, ethics review, informed consent, and accident insurance.
Standardization plans propose ISO/TC173 proposals (ISO 10535 revision, robotic walking aids, ISO 17966) and JIS B 8446-2.
